title: Module categories over representations of SL_q(2) and graphs
note: Classifies indecomposable semisimple module categories over $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SL}_q(2))$ at generic $q$ by graphs; the rank-one module categories are the fibre functors, matching Bichon's $B(E)$ classification. Cited alongside bichon2003 for the same eightfold front-2 result. Added 2026-09-03. Checked 2026-11-22: the DOI, journal, volume 11, issue 1 and year 2004 are from the MaRDI record (zbMATH 1053.17010), whose DOI encodes v11.n1. Pages 103-114 are still NOT confirmed by any source read. arXiv preprint math/0302130 (v1, 2003-02-11).
